about.label: ABOUT
intro: I may be small in size, but I’ve got a big job — I’m a conscience, a voice of reason, and sometimes a bit of a chatterbox. I was appointed to guide Pinocchio on his journey to become a real boy, teaching him right from wrong and reminding him that every choice has consequences.

I’m dressed quite neatly — I always wear my top hat, carry my umbrella, and try to keep a gentlemanly look. Even though I’m just a cricket, I like to think I’ve got a human heart. I believe in honesty, courage, and selflessness — the values that truly make someone ‘real.’ Of course, I’m not perfect either; I make mistakes, get scared, and sometimes doubt myself. But I always do my best to help others find their way, even when the path is difficult.
After all, being a conscience isn’t easy — but someone’s got to do it!.
